---
title: "Programme"
description: "Programme overview for the Japan QCA Conference 2026"
---

::: {.coming-soon}
**Detailed timetable TBA**

The conference will take place on 30–31 October 2026. In-person sessions will be held at Komatsu Hall, Building 121, B1F, Waseda University. The PDW is in person, while the EW is hybrid, combining in-person and online participation. Session times, online access arrangements, and the final running order will be published after confirmation.
:::

## Plenary session

**Carsten Schneider** and **Peer Fiss** will deliver keynote speeches during the plenary session.

## Expert roundtable

An expert roundtable will discuss the progress of QCA practices and provide space for exchange on current methodological questions.

## Panel sessions

Panel sessions will introduce and discuss the latest methodological developments in QCA.

## Paper Development Workshop

Paper developers will meet in small roundtable sessions to receive detailed, constructive feedback from QCA experts on empirical projects using QCA and related methods.

## Expert Workshop

The EW is organized as a discussion forum rather than a conventional paper-presentation session. It focuses on methodological issues related to QCA and related methods.

The final programme will identify session times, speakers, rooms, breaks, and participant guidance once these details have been confirmed.
